title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing: Recording a Document as Checked and Found Good
content:
Where a document a Keyturn Vehicle Listing depends on has been checked by the marketplace and found good, a verification record is filed on the vehicle's condition record. One record names the document checked, who checked it and how many images of it the marketplace now holds on file, and every such record is filed as passed. The listing's own standing, class and price are untouched; what the host and the desk see afterwards is a verification entry dated today that later readings of the vehicle's document history return.

A document is checked by the marketplace's own inspector against the vehicle rather than on the host's word, and the verification is recorded under that channel whoever sent the document in.

### Making the entry

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `verify_listing_document_28456ce9` and calls it. One call files one verification.

### Parameters

- `vehicle_id` — the listing reference number of the vehicle the document belongs to, read from the vehicle listing lookup before the call.
- `customer_id` — the member reference number of the host who owns that listing, read from the member profile lookup before the call.
- `document_kind` — the document this record verifies, exactly one of: `none`, the record verifies no document at all; `registration`, the vehicle's state or provincial registration certificate; `title`, the ownership title document for the vehicle; `lienholder_consent`, the written consent of the finance company or lessor named on the title; `insurance_certificate`, the certificate of the host's own motor insurance; `recall_clearance`, a workshop's confirmation that a safety recall has been carried out.
- `inspection_channel` — who carried the check out, exactly one of: `self_photo`, the host supplied photographs of the document themselves; `partner_shop`, a partner workshop confirmed the document while holding the vehicle; `mobile_inspector`, a marketplace inspector checked the document against the vehicle; `telematics_report`, the fitted telematics unit supplied the evidence.
- `verification_image_count` — how many images of the document the marketplace holds on file once this check is recorded, as a whole number of images with no decimal part, no unit suffix and no thousands separator; zero means no image is held.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number minted for the new verification record, the listing it was filed against, the document checked and the number of images held on file. The presence of that reference number in the sentence is what indicates the verification now stands on the vehicle's condition record.
